# Historical notification lastUpdate validation is not the current refresh contract

1349 repairs a missing, non-integer or future persisted lastUpdate by resetting it to zero and adds initialization assertions for seeds and interaction IDs. This is a useful dated persistence-validation pattern. Accepted updater scheduling uses cache expiration and returns loadFromCache/hasCache; the captured accepted InAppNotifications module has no lastUpdate field. Do not apply the 2024 timestamp guard as a description of current refresh scheduling. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/components/inappnotifications.
